narrative:
October has NOK 1,357M under close across 12 feeds. 96.8% of records have landed (gate 96%) and 93.8% are auto-matched (gate 93%), leaving NOK 84.7M unmatched.

The Business Central OData API timed out after 1.4M of 2.1M October journal lines, the same failure as September. This time the ingestion agent switched to paged extraction from the Data Lake replica and reconciled to the BC trial balance automatically. In September, finance spent three days on a manual Data Lake workaround.

The close is forecast at WD+6, against WD+11 in September.
